title: Application of Fitchburg Gas & Electric Light Company (1) under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, Department of Telecommunications and Energy of a change in the quarterly Fuel Charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billing month of February, 1998 and possibly for additional months. The Fuel Charge reflects changes in prudently incurred, reasonable costs of fuel and power purchased by the Company; and (2) for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchases of power, pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00. The rules established in 220 C.M.R. 8.00 and implement the intent of §§ 201 and 210 of the Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
